description: Map conservation (two homolog tiers) onto solvent accessibility of the Der p 23 crystal structure to locate conserved exposed surface
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ===========================================================================
# PROVENANCE: Der p 23 per-residue conservation (two tiers) x heavy-atom RSA
# from PDB 4ZCE chain A.  Note: 4ZCE residue 43 is Thr (cloning scar, SEQRES
# begins SER-PHE-THR-LYS); UniProt L7N6F8 position 43 is Asp.  All other
# modelled residues 44-90 match L7N6F8 exactly.
# ===========================================================================
def up_tsv(q,size=500,fields="accession,protein_name,organism_name,length,sequence"):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={'query':q,'size':size,'format':'tsv','fields':fields},timeout=120)
    L=r.text.strip().split("\n"); h=L[0].split("\t")
    return [dict(zip(h,l.split("\t"))) for l in L[1:]]
pool=up_tsv("(xref:pfam-PF01607) AND (taxonomy_id:83137) AND (length:[40 TO 200])")
DERP23="MKFNIIIVFISLAILVHSSYAANDNDDDPTTTVHPTTTEQPDDKFECPSRFGYFADPKDPHKFYICSNWEAVHKDCPGNTRWNEDEETCT"
CORE=DERP23[42:]
CLASS={**{a:'h' for a in "AVLIMFWYC"},**{a:'p' for a in "STNQGP"},**{a:'+' for a in "KRH"},**{a:'-' for a in "DE"}}
def sc(a,b):
    if a==b: return 9 if a=='C' else 4
    return 1 if CLASS.get(a)==CLASS.get(b) else -2
def nw(s1,s2,g=8):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); prev=-g*np.arange(m+1,dtype=float); j=np.arange(m+1)
    S=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],dtype=float)
    tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8); tb[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        base=np.empty(m+1); base[0]=-g*i
        diag=prev[:-1]+S[i-1]; up=prev[1:]-g; base[1:]=np.maximum(diag,up)
        t=np.maximum.accumulate(base+g*j); cur=np.maximum(base,t-g*j)
        tb[i,1:]=np.where(cur[1:]>base[1:],2,np.where(diag>=up,1,3)); tb[i,0]=3
        prev=cur
    i,jj=n,m; A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or jj>0:
        d=tb[i,jj]
        if i==0: d=2
        elif jj==0: d=3
        if d==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append(s2[jj-1]);i-=1;jj-=1
        elif d==2: A.append('-');B.append(s2[jj-1]);jj-=1
        else: A.append(s1[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(B[::-1])

hits=[]
for p in pool:
    s=p.get('Sequence','')
    if not s or len(s)>220 or p['Entry']=='L7N6F8': continue
    a,b=nw(CORE,s); al=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!='-' and y!='-']
    ident=sum(x==y for x,y in al)/len(CORE)*100
    hits.append((p['Entry'],p['Organism'].split('(')[0].strip(),round(ident,1),s))
tier1=[h for h in hits if h[2]>=70]          # group-23 orthologs (Dermatophagoides)
tier2=[h for h in hits if 50<=h[2]<70]       # wider Astigmata/Oribatida CBM14 paralogs
print("tier1 (>=70%% id, group-23 orthologs) n=%d:"%len(tier1), [(h[0],h[2]) for h in tier1])
print("tier2 (50-70%% id, CBM14 paralogs)   n=%d"%len(tier2))

def profile(seqs):
    cons=np.zeros(90); cov=np.zeros(90)
    for acc,org,idp,s in seqs:
        a,b=nw(DERP23,s); qi=0
        for x,y in zip(a,b):
            if x!='-':
                if y!='-':
                    cov[qi]+=1
                    if x==y: cons[qi]+=1
                qi+=1
    return np.where(cov>0,cons/np.maximum(cov,1)*100,0.0), cov
p1,c1=profile(tier1); p2,c2=profile(tier2)

# ---------------- heavy-atom SASA, 4ZCE chain A ----------------
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
MAXASA={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLU':223,'GLN':225,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,
 'ILE':197,'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,'TYR':263,'VAL':174}
pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4ZCE.pdb",timeout=120).text
at=[]
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A") or l[21]!="A": continue
    el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
    if el in ("H","D"): continue
    at.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),el=el,
                   xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))))
def sasa(at,n=960,p=1.4):
    x=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in at]); r=np.array([RAD.get(a['el'],1.8) for a in at])+p
    i=np.arange(n)+0.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    sp=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
    d=np.linalg.norm(x[:,None]-x[None],axis=-1); o=np.zeros(len(at))
    for k in range(len(at)):
        nb=np.where((d[k]<r[k]+r)&(np.arange(len(at))!=k))[0]; pts=x[k]+r[k]*sp
        acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-x[nb][None],axis=-1)>=r[nb][None]).all(1) if len(nb) else np.ones(n,bool)
        o[k]=4*np.pi*r[k]**2*acc.mean()
    return o
S=sasa(at); res={}
for a,s_ in zip(at,S): res[(a['resi'],a['resn'])]=res.get((a['resi'],a['resn']),0)+s_
A3=dict(zip(["ALA","CYS","ASP","GLU","PHE","GLY","HIS","ILE","LYS","LEU","MET","ASN","PRO","GLN","ARG","SER","THR","VAL","TRP","TYR"],"ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"))
rows=[]
for (resi,resn),sa in sorted(res.items()):
    rows.append(dict(resi=resi,aa=A3[resn],sasa=round(sa,1),rsa=round(sa/MAXASA[resn]*100,1),
                     id_orth=round(float(p1[resi-1]),1),id_para=round(float(p2[resi-1]),1),
                     n_orth=int(c1[resi-1]),n_para=int(c2[resi-1])))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
tab['tag']=np.where((tab.id_para>=75)&(tab.rsa>=30),'conserved+exposed',
            np.where((tab.id_para>=75)&(tab.rsa<15),'conserved+buried',''))
print("\n=== conserved across the wider CBM14 paralog set (>=75% id) AND exposed (RSA>=30%) ===")
print(tab[tab.tag=='conserved+exposed'].to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== conserved (>=75%) AND buried (RSA<15%) ===")
print(tab[tab.tag=='conserved+buried'].to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== all residues, 4ZCE chain A (43-90) ===")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),sharex=True)
x=tab.resi.values
ax[0].bar(x-0.2,tab.id_orth,0.4,color='#1f77b4',label='group 23 orthologs (n=%d)'%len(tier1))
ax[0].bar(x+0.2,tab.id_para,0.4,color='#aec7e8',label='wider CBM14 paralogs (n=%d)'%len(tier2))
ax[0].set_ylabel('identity to Der p 23 (%)'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].set_ylim(0,105)
ax[0].set_title('Der p 23 residues 43-90: sequence conservation (top) and solvent exposure in 4ZCE chain A (bottom)')
col=['#d62728' if a in 'FWYH' else ('#ff7f0e' if a=='C' else '#7f7f7f') for a in tab.aa]
ax[1].bar(x,tab.rsa,0.75,color=col)
ax[1].axhline(30,ls='--',c='k',lw=0.8); ax[1].set_ylabel('relative SASA (%)'); ax[1].set_xlabel('L7N6F8 residue number')
ax[1].set_xticks(x[::2]); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{a}{i}" for a,i in zip(tab.aa[::2],x[::2])],rotation=90,fontsize=7)
for i,r in tab.iterrows():
    if r.tag=='conserved+exposed': ax[1].text(r.resi,r.rsa+2,r.aa,ha='center',fontsize=7,color='green')
ax[1].text(0.01,0.95,'red = aromatic, orange = Cys, dashed line = RSA 30%',transform=ax[1].transAxes,fontsize=8,va='top')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
